title: JCGS seed1 synchronous CUDA index failure attribution
purpose: Locate the exact gather kernel, epoch, world and batch responsible for the repeatable seed1 epoch4 CUDA index failure before any further method correction or three-seed run.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 diagnostic replay: seed1, at most five epochs, C01-C06 gradients and C07 validation only, synchronous CUDA and batch trace; no C08/C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User requested autonomous continuous work; repeated V1/V1R system failures require exact synchronous attribution before another correction.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C07 deduplicated causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed V1 and V1R CUDA failures.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: 60 C01-C06 worlds, exact seed1 deterministic order for at most five epochs.
worlds.selection: C07 loss is computed only to reproduce the exact train/eval mode sequence; no checkpoint is selected for science.
worlds.forbidden: C08, C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Exact V1R seed1 order, batches, shifts, model, optimizer and loss. CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 and one JSON context line before every batch. Stop at first assert or after epoch5 before development inference.

teacher.source: Same frozen exit and global geometry Teacher used by V1/V1R.
teacher.use: Reproduce the failing loss only; no target correction or index clamping.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid frames only.

split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: No scientific selection or threshold; C07 preserves exact evaluation transitions.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Starts from seed1 initialization; no failed checkpoint is loaded.

methods.main: Exact seed1 five-epoch replay with synchronous CUDA and batch-level context; no change to model or loss.
methods.baseline: V1 and V1R both fail asynchronously in seed1 epoch4 with CUDA scatter/gather out-of-bounds.
methods.fallback: If failure does not reproduce, stop after epoch5 before C08 and classify the asynchronous condition as unresolved; do not infer or tune.

acceptance.reproduction: First CUDA assert is reproduced under CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 or the five-epoch non-reproduction is explicitly sealed.
acceptance.localization: On reproduction, preserve exact Python/kernel call line plus last epoch/world/batch/shift/global-index/target-index context.
acceptance.integrity: Model, loss, data order and optimizer match V1R; no corrective clamp or retry.

failure_policy: This is attribution, not capacity evidence. Never reuse its checkpoint. Any input/environment drift is system FAIL.
retention: Raw synchronous log, parsed diagnosis, environment, commands, RUN_STATE and seal; diagnostic checkpoint may be retained only for traceback reproduction.

estimated_cost.compute: One seed1 CUDA replay for at most five epochs
